narrative.overview: The actual WinMorph template supplies the visual structure: an application screenshot fills the viewport behind a centered name and immediately usable installation controls. Scrolling reduces that image to a readable screen, then advances six real application views in the same pinned stage. Quiet moving color fields connect the states; comparison and MCP continue on the same dark ground.
keyCharacteristics: Full-viewport application imagery becomes a contained screen through scroll.
Terminal and file installation share the first viewport.
Six features share one pinned stage and progress rail.
Dark surfaces, square controls and restrained template-derived color fields.

rules.name: The Shared Stage Rule
rules.body: Keep scroll, keyboard and tab selection connected to the same decoded screenshot and caption.

rules.name: The Reading and Commands Rule
rules.body: Use Inter Tight for reading and Martian Mono for executable commands.

dos: Do preserve the actual template structure, first-viewport installation and six-state gallery.
Do decode a requested screenshot before changing its selected tab and caption.
Do retain bilingual copy, keyboard navigation, visible focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep runtime units together and expose exact tested versions and methodology.
donts: Don't add rounded cards, pill containers or repeated installation areas.
Don't replace real app imagery with an unrelated decorative background.
Don't turn the scroll gallery into an automatic slideshow.
Don't extend the template color-field exception into arbitrary gradients or glows.
